author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Spring in Yunnan always brings many flavors that are too precious to miss. They are not available all year round, nor can they be found whenever you want them. You have to catch them while the breeze is still soft, while the morning dew still lingers, and while the plants in the hills and fields are just at their most tender. Only then can you gather these flavors of spring, one by one, and carefully turn them into a full table of dishes.

This episode is a collection of spring’s freshest tastes.
Some are tender shoots just pushing up from the mountains, some are crisp new growth from the fields, and some are seasonal flavors that, once missed, will not return until next year. They may look like simple, ordinary ingredients, but once they meet the fire, the delicate freshness and fragrance of a Yunnan spring slowly begin to unfold.
